qualityPolicy: This is a source/isnād research audit, not a certified canonical Tafsīr entry. Do not convert page presence into ṣaḥīḥ/ḥasan. Arabic fragments are excerpted from named source, not new fabricated Qurʾān or aḥādīṯ.

candidates.report: aṭ-Ṭabarī gives own grammatical explanation and report 6751 via Jābir about Allah's pleasure; no independent full rijāl/ʿilal check of 6751
candidates.isnad: Muḥammad ibn Bashshār → Abū Aḥmad az-Zubayrī → Sufyān → Muḥammad ibn al-Munkadir → Jābir (6751)
candidates.next: Examine marfūʿ/mauqūf status and compare exact Jābir report against early collections; verify individual narrators.

candidates.report: The inspected aṭ-Ṭabarī section is primarily his own grammatical/lexical explanation of the duʿāʾ; no separately authenticated early Āṯar isolated.
candidates.next: Seek Ibn Abī Ḥātim direct early report; do not attribute Ṭabarī's own explanation to Salaf.

candidates.report: Reports 6760 (as-Suddī) and 6762 (Muǧāhid) located; 6762 glosses بالقسط as بالعدل; Ibn Abī Naǧīḥ's transmission of Mujāhid's Tafsīr needs an explicit manuscript-mediated hearing caveat.
candidates.isnad: 6762: al-Muṯannā → Abū Ḥuḏayfah → Šibl → Ibn Abī Naǧīḥ → Muǧāhid
candidates.next: Check alternative independent chains and whether a connected ṣaḥīḥ attribution is warranted.

candidates.report: aṭ-Ṭabarī gives his own exposition; 6773 is Ibn Isḥāq → Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar ibn az-Zubayr through Ibn Ḥumayd/Salamah. No completed rijāl/continuity assessment.
candidates.isnad: Ibn Ḥumayd → Salamah → Ibn Isḥāq → Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar ibn az-Zubayr
candidates.next: Check report continuity and corroborating early Tafsīr before using as a canonical attribution.

candidates.report: Report 6776 via Ibn Ḥumayd → Salamah → Ibn Isḥāq → Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar ibn az-Zubayr; text of verse explained by aṭ-Ṭabarī, but report's chain not established.
candidates.isnad: Ibn Ḥumayd → Salamah → Ibn Isḥāq → Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar ibn az-Zubayr
candidates.next: Seek direct early companion/Tābiʿī Tafsīr with independently checked chain.

candidates.report: Only aṭ-Ṭabarī's own explanation of nullified deeds isolated in the inspected section, no authenticated early individual report.
candidates.next: Check Ibn Abī Ḥātim for directly relevant early attribution.

candidates.report: Direct Qatādah Tafsīr report 6786 located with strong early transmission route. Bishr ibn Muʿādh is ṣadūq; Yazīd ibn Zurayʿ is an early reliable transmitter from Saʿīd ibn Abī ʿArūbah before his ikhtilāṭ; Saʿīd is particularly established in Qatādah. Final individual ʿilal and duplicate proof still required before canonical inclusion.
candidates.arabic: لَنْ تَمَسَّنَا النَّارُ إِلَّا تَحِلَّةَ الْقَسَمِ الَّتِي نَصَبْنَا فِيهَا الْعِجْلَ ... وَغَرَّهُمْ فِي دِينِهِمْ مَا كَانُوا يَفْتَرُونَ
candidates.isnad: aṭ-Ṭabarī → Bišr ibn Muʿāḏ al-ʿAqadī → Yazīd ibn Zurayʿ → Saʿīd ibn Abī ʿArūbah → Qatādah (6786)
candidates.gradingAssessment: Promising/likely acceptable to Qatādah; not certified as ṣaḥīḥ until independent final check. Maqtūʿ Tafsīr, not marfūʿ ḥadīṯ.
candidates.next: Verify exact Arabic in edition, cross-check 6786 against another witness, duplicate/canonical status and validators before adding.

candidates.report: The inspected aṭ-Ṭabarī section explains the verse in his own prose; no early individual chain found in that section.
candidates.next: Seek early companion/Tābiʿī interpretation in Ibn Abī Ḥātim.

candidates.report: aṭ-Ṭabarī report 6839 attributes a direct comment to as-Suddī via Mūsā → ʿAmr → Asbāṭ; isnād and transmission history remain unassessed.
candidates.arabic: أخبرهم أنه يعلم ما أسروا من ذلك وما أعلنوا
candidates.next: Verify narrator identities, chain and wording independently.

candidates.report: aṭ-Ṭabarī reports al-Ḥasan's context claim (6845–6846) but explicitly says the alleged occasion lacks an established authentic report; 6849 is Ibn Isḥāq through Ibn Ḥumayd. Do not publish any as verified occasion of revelation.
candidates.arabic: وأما ما روى الحسن ... فلا خبر به عندنا يصح
candidates.next: Find a sound direct early explanatory Āṯar not reliant on the rejected sabab report.

followUpOnPreviouslyAudited.isnad: Both routes converge on Ibn Abī Naǧīḥ → Muǧāhid.
followUpOnPreviouslyAudited.newCriticalFinding: Classical rijāl discussion reports Ibn Abī Naǧīḥ did not hear Mujāhid's full Tafsīr directly and received the material through al-Qāsim ibn Abī Bazzah's book. This must be recorded as a transmission caveat; do not label the two routes independently ṣaḥīḥ by merely counting them.
